title: Playing to Win
author: A.G. Lafley, Roger L. Martin

lockedEdition.name: Playing to Win: How Strategy Really Works

rationale: The 2013 English-original Harvard Business Review Press edition family is the dominant canonical working text in the official and authorized metadata trail.
Google Books, O'Reilly authorized preview pages, MIT Bookstore metadata, and the Case Centre chapter catalog all point to the same eight numbered chapters with no material chapter-order divergence.
No translation or revised-edition ambiguity surfaced that would materially change chapter count, chapter order, or chapter-level interpretation for this run.

candidateEditionsReviewed.label: 2013 English original trade family
candidateEditionsReviewed.reason: Strongest combined official, authorized-preview, and metadata support with a stable eight-chapter map.

candidateEditionsReviewed.label: Alternate ebook / library preview variants
candidateEditionsReviewed.reason: Useful as authorized-preview support, but they preserve the same chapter structure and do not require a separate lock decision.

candidateEditionsReviewed.label: Translations and later reprints
candidateEditionsReviewed.reason: No translated edition was requested, and no material chapter-level divergence was needed for the English run.

notes: Treat the 2013 English trade family as one stable working text family for this run.
Use paraphrase-first because the frozen bundle is metadata-plus-preview-plus-secondary rather than a full licensed local text.
